AboutControl.description: The control loop's mode, ticks and state.

AdapterStatus.description: The command adapter: holds, queue, verification, budget and counters.

AlarmEvent.description: A journalled alarm or hold transition.

AlarmsPage.description: ``GET alarms``: the active alarms and the events in a window.

ApplyResult.description: ``PUT config`` and ``POST config/rollback``: the new version and configuration.

ArbiterEntry.description: What the arbiter decided for one intent.

ArchiveDeleteResult.description: ``POST archive/delete``: the months removed and the archive afterwards.

ArchiveGroup.description: A calendar year or heating season with stored months.

ArchiveMonth.description: One stored month: frozen (final) or open (being built).

ArchiveRun.description: What the archive's last step did (``null`` without a history writer).

ArchiveStatus.description: ``GET archive``: whether the archive runs, what it holds and what it costs.

AuditPage.description: ``GET audit``: audit events in a window.

Champion.description: The promoted model named by the learner's ``current.json``.

CheckGroup.description: One phase of the checklist: readiness, counts and item ids.

CommandEvent.description: A command life-cycle event as the adapter reports it (with a decision, a write).

CommandLogEntry.description: One journalled command event (journal column order: ``detail`` last).

CommandsPage.description: ``GET commands``: command events in a window.

CompactResult.description: ``POST history/compact``: whether the request was queued, and the state.

ConfigExport.description: ``GET config/export``: the stored values and every non-secret effective value.

ConfigField.description: One field of the configuration: effective value, source, lock, stored value, default.

ConfigMode.description: The configured and effective mode, pause and pending reset.

ConfigSchema.description: ``GET config/schema``: field definitions, groups, presets per emitter, envelope.

ConfigVersion.description: A stored configuration version; ``values`` only from ``config/versions/{number}``.

Corrections.description: Recent corrective writes against their limit.

CoverageDay.description: Stored decisions of one local day of the window.

CoverageVersion.description: Stored decisions of one configuration version in the window.

CurveChange.description: A heating curve as a configuration change (``null`` when there is none).

CurveOutlook.description: The curve's water temperature on the forecast.

DeadmanStatus.description: The dead-man ping; only ``configured`` without a notifier.

Decision.description: One journalled decision: the summary columns, the arbiter, commands and the record.

DecisionRecord.description: The core's complete explanation of one controller tick (schema 1).

DecisionSeries.description: ``GET decisions/series``: the controller's decisions as columns over time.

DecisionsLatest.description: ``GET decisions/latest``: the newest decision and the control state.

DefrostState.description:
The live defrost as the safety monitor latched it at its start.

``mode`` is the deice mode the unit picks (1: reverse cycle, water pump running;
2: hot gas, water pump off by design); ``None`` for an unknown model. Everything
but ``active`` is ``None`` outside a defrost; ``max_s`` is the ``defrost_stuck``
limit in effect.

DeliveryError.description: The last failed send or ping.

Derived.description: A derived signal with the reason it has no value.

Divergence.description: ``GET shadow/divergence``: ovenbird against the pump's setpoint, with episodes.

DivergenceDay.description: The divergence of one local day.

DivergenceSeries.description: Ovenbird's and the pump's setpoints as columns over time.

DivergenceSummary.description: Ovenbird against the pump's setpoint over the window.

Envelope.description: The safety envelope around the heating curve.

EnvelopeBand.description: The envelope band at the current outside temperature.

EnvelopeCorrections.description: Ovenbird's corrective writes against their limit, and in total.

EnvelopeEvidence.description: The last correction of the pump's envelope rule ovenbird recognised.

EnvelopeRule.description: Whether the pump's own envelope rule is declared and seen acting.

Episode.description: A run of minutes with a divergence above the threshold.

EpisodeMark.description: A stored explanation of an episode.

EpisodeNote.description: Why an episode is explained, by whom and when.

ExplainResult.description: ``POST shadow/episodes/explain``: the mark, ``null`` after a removal.

FieldDef.description: The schema of one configuration field.

ForecastError.description: Bias and mean absolute error of the stored forecasts per lead.

ForecastSeries.description: The forecast hours: time, temperature, radiation, cloud cover, wind.

HaConnection.description: The Home Assistant link (``connected`` ``null`` when not configured).

HaConnectionResult.description: ``PUT config/ha``: the configuration after the connection change.

HaEntityCheck.description: What a connection test found for one ``ha/`` signal.

HaLinkState.description: Whether Home Assistant is configured and connected, and its temperature unit.

HaTestResult.description: ``POST config/ha/test``: the outcome of a read-only connection test.

Health.description: ``GET health``: liveness, readiness, version and the component checks.

HealthMessage.description: The health body, whenever it changed.

History.description: ``GET history``: the requested signals over a window.

HistorySignals.description: ``GET history/signals``: every signal with stored history.

HistoryStorage.description: ``GET history/storage``: sizes, ranges, the projection and the compaction state.

HotWaterState.description: Whether the UI shows hot water: the setting, the pump's report and the outcome.

HouseHistoryModel.description: A promoted model of the learner's index and its score at the current floor area.

HouseReady.description:
``GET insight/house`` with a promoted model: the learner's insight and the score.

The learner's keys are passed through; ``proposal`` gains ``current_curve`` and
``stale`` (whether the curve changed since the run).

HouseScore.description: The indicative insulation score, recomputed for the current floor area.

HouseWaiting.description: ``GET insight/house`` before a model is promoted: what is missing.

InFlight.description: The command published and not yet verified.

InputRef.description: An input a decision used, with its provenance.

InsightDaily.description: ``GET insight/daily``: the last days, oldest first.

InsightDay.description: One local day of energy, runs, temperatures and comfort.

InsightRuns.description: ``GET insight/runs``: compressor runs per local day and in total.

Intent.description: A command intent returned with a decision record.

LastRun.description: The allow-listed essentials of the learner's last run (``status.json``).

LearnerHealth.description: When the learner last ran and whether that is too long ago.

LiveTicket.description: ``POST live/ticket``: a single-use pass for the WebSocket.

ModeChange.description: ``POST control/pause`` and ``control/resume``: the new mode and the control state.

Monitor.description: The result of one safety monitor.

MqttApplyState.description:
The last broker change: ``idle``, ``applying``, ``applied``, ``reverted`` or ``failed``.

``failed``: the change gave no live HeishaMon data and putting the previous broker
back failed (alarm ``mqtt_revert_failed``).

MqttConnectionResult.description: ``PUT config/mqtt``: the configuration and the link after the change.

MqttStatus.description: ``GET config/mqtt``: the broker link and the last change made in the app.

MqttTestResult.description: ``POST config/mqtt/test``: the outcome of a subscribe-only broker test.

NotReady.description: A go-live item that is not ok.

NotificationStatus.description: ``GET notifications/status``: what is configured, sent and failing (no secrets).

NotifyTest.description: The outcome of a test notification.

NotifyTestResult.description: ``POST notifications/test``: the test's outcome and the status after it.

NtfyStatus.description: The ntfy channel; only ``configured`` without a notifier.

OpenLoopRun.description: The candidate replayed over the recorded decisions (open loop).

OpenLoopSeries.description: The recorded and replayed setpoints of the window.

OpenLoopSummary.description: How the candidate differs from what was recorded.

PastForecast.description: What the forecast said at a fixed lead for the hours that passed.

PreviewNow.description: The current tick decided with the active and the candidate configuration.

PreviewResult.description:
``POST config/preview``: the validation, and for a valid candidate *now* and the open loop.

``now`` is ``null`` without a control loop.

ProposalDraft.description:
``POST insight/house/proposal/draft``: the proposal as a configuration draft.

``points`` is the learner's; ``validation`` is ``null`` without a configuration store.

PumpSetting.description: One row of the pump settings; only the writable rows carry the write keys.

PumpSettingsPage.description: ``GET pump/settings``: whether writes are possible, the model and its profile, every row.

PumpSnapshot.description: The pump's own settings, captured at go-live or by hand.

PumpWrite.description: The last operator write of a setting and how it ended.

PumpWriteResult.description: ``202`` of ``POST pump/settings/{id}``: the queued command event.

RecordInstant.description: The tick's instant on both clock axes.

ReleaseHoldResult.description: ``POST control/release-hold``: the released hold and what still holds.

ReleaseItem.description: One pump value a release restores.

ReleaseRun.description: A release of control to the pump, or a rehearsal of it.

ReleaseStarted.description: ``POST control/release``: the started release (``202`` while it runs).

ReleaseState.description: ``GET control/release``: the running or last release and the last rehearsals.

ReplayConfig.description: The configuration a replay ran with: the active one, a stored version or a draft.

ReplayCoverage.description: ``GET replay/coverage``: where stored decisions exist, per day and version.

ReplayDay.description: Writes of one local day: replayed, recorded setpoint changes and commands sent.

ReplayEpisode.description: A run of minutes with the replayed setpoint away from the pump's target.

ReplayIdentity.description:
Whether replaying each tick with its own version reproduced every recorded setpoint.

``ok`` is ``null`` when no tick could be compared.

ReplayJob.description: ``POST replay`` and ``GET replay/{id}``: a replay job and, when done, its result.

ReplayResult.description: A finished replay (open loop: no comfort or energy claim follows from it).

ReplaySeries.description: The recorded, replayed and pump setpoints per step (the last value of each step).

ReplaySummary.description: What the chosen configuration would have done, against the pump and the recording.

ResetAckResult.description: ``POST config/reset-ack``: the mode and the configuration after the acknowledgement.

RetentionPreset.description: One simple retention choice: its settings and the size it would come to.

RoomStatus.description: The room input: profile, held and alive ages, link.

RunBin.description: A histogram bin of run lengths (``to_min`` ``null`` for the last, open bin).

RunDay.description: The run statistics of one local day.

RunStats.description: Compressor run statistics of a span.

Safety.description: The safety monitor: overall level and every monitor.

SafetyNet.description: The safety net: the envelope rule, the band now and the hard limits.

SchemaGroup.description: A settings group and its fields, in display order.

ScoreBand.description: An indicative band and the heat loss per m2 it lies below.

Signal.description: One signal of the snapshot: value, provenance and freshness.

SignalCandidate.description:
A signal the room, liveness or cross-check picker offers.

Home Assistant candidates also carry their entity id and, when Home Assistant's
registry could be read, the area name and the device id (the liveness picker
lists the room sensor's own device first). ``pump_mirror`` is true for a Home
Assistant entity on a device whose entities copy the heat pump's HeishaMon values;
the pickers list those apart.

SignalRange.description: The stored range of one signal at one resolution (``step`` 0 is raw).

Snapshot.description: ``GET snapshot``: every signal, the derived values and the defrost at one instant.

SnapshotItem.description: A pump value the snapshot holds.

SnapshotMessage.description: The latest snapshot (at most once per snapshot interval).

SnapshotState.description: ``GET`` and ``POST control/snapshot``: the snapshot and whether one can be captured.

SteppedSeries.description: A series at a fixed step (seconds).

StorageFiles.description: Sizes in bytes of the files in the data directory and its free space.

StorageResolution.description: What one resolution holds and what it costs per day.

StoredSignal.description: One signal with history: id, unit, kind and its range per resolution.

StoveResult.description: ``POST control/stove``: the accepted request and wood-stove mode.

StoveStatus.description: Wood-stove mode: configuration, state and the request.

SystemAbout.description: ``GET system/about``: version, uptime, connections and the control state.

Term.description: One named contribution to the water setpoint.

TrialCheck.description: One item of the go-live checklist; ``evidence`` differs per item.

TrialCriterion.description: A cut-over criterion: the trial against the baseline.

TrialPeriod.description: One period's figures: room, outside, runs and writes.

TrialStatus.description: ``GET trial/status``: the go-live checklist and the trial summary.

TrialSummary.description: The trial against the baseline, the trial's state and length.

ValidateResult.description: ``POST config/validate``: errors, warnings and the changed fields' effective values.

ValidationIssue.description: An error or warning of a configuration change.

VersionChange.description: A field's stored value before and after a version (absent is ``null``).

VersionIdentityModel.description: The identity check of one configuration version.

WeatherLocation.description: The forecast location (rounded to 0.01°) and where it came from.

WeatherNow.description: The outside temperature now: measured, filtered, forecast, and the curve's water.

WeatherOff.description: ``GET weather`` while no forecast is fetched.

get.description: ``GET archive``: whether the archive runs, the stored months, years and seasons.

post.description: ``POST archive/delete``: delete a frozen month or every frozen month of a year.

get.description: ``GET archive/months/{month}``: one month's zip (the open month as it stands).
``GET archive/seasons/{season}``: the frozen months of a heating season (Aug-Jul).
``GET archive/years/{year}``: the frozen months of a calendar year and a manifest.
``GET audit``: audit events (JSON or CSV).

post.description: ``POST control/pause``: pause control (nothing is sent until resumed).

get.description: ``GET control/release``: the last release and rehearsals.

post.description: ``POST control/release``: hand control back to the pump (or rehearse it).
``POST control/release-hold``: release a foreign-writer or verification hold.

get.description: ``GET control/snapshot``: the go-live snapshot and whether one can be captured.

post.description: ``POST control/snapshot``: capture the pump's settings by hand.
``POST control/stove``: switch wood-stove mode on or off.

get.description: ``GET decisions/series``: the controller's decisions over time.
``GET diagnostics``: the redacted diagnostics bundle as a download.
``GET export/archive``: a fresh copy of ``history.db``, the configuration and a manifest.
``GET export/journal/{kind}``: decisions, commands, alarms or forecasts, streamed.
``GET export/series``: signal history as a streamed CSV or NDJSON download.

post.description: ``POST history/compact``: compact ``history.db`` now (the writer pauses meanwhile).

get.description: ``GET history/signals``: every signal with stored history and its range per resolution.
``GET history/storage``: database size per table and resolution, and the projection.
``GET insight/runs``: compressor runs per local day.
``GET notifications/status``: what is configured, sent and failing (no secrets).

post.description: ``POST notifications/test``: send a test notification at once.
``POST replay``: start a replay of a period with the chosen configuration.

get.description:
``GET replay/coverage``: where stored decisions exist, per day and version.

The history database is read in a worker thread, never on the event loop.
``GET replay/{id}``: a replay's phase and progress, and its result when done.
``GET shadow/divergence``: ovenbird against the pump's setpoint, with episodes.

post.description: ``POST shadow/episodes/explain``: mark (or unmark) an episode as explained.

get.description: ``GET system/about``: version, uptime, connections and the control state.
``GET trial/status``: the go-live checklist and the trial summary.
